scanCancelled: Scan cancelled. Results found so far are kept.
scanPaused: This scan is paused or owned by another panel. Click Scan project to restart.
scan_changed: The scan changed or was reclaimed. Scan the project again.
environmentHelp: Define named environments as JSON. All variable values must be strings. Use {{name}} in the URL, header values and body. Settings are saved per project in plugin storage as plain text; avoid storing passwords here.
headers: Request headers (one Name: value per line)
networkHelp: HTTPS to declared and granted hosts; HTTP only to localhost / 127.0.0.1. Add HTTPS hosts to plugin.toml before installing. Replace route parameters such as {id} before sending. Requests run one at a time, with a 30 s timeout.
notScanned: Click Scan project to discover endpoints.
fileQueryLimited: An IDE file query reached 10,000 results. Module queries were added, but some files may still be missing.
indexLimited: The index reached the 64 MiB memory guard; results are incomplete.
scanComplete: Scan complete. Select a route to edit a request; double-click or use Go to code to navigate.
noMatches: No matching endpoints. Supported: Java/Kotlin Spring MVC, OpenFeign and JAX-RS literal mappings.
environmentFormat: Use an object of named environments, each containing string variables.
project: Open a trusted project first, then reopen RESTful Tools.
project_changed: The active project changed. Reloading its environments; retry the operation.
variable_syntax: An environment variable is missing its closing }}.
variable_cycle: Environment variables contain a cycle or exceed 16 levels.
url: Enter an absolute HTTP(S) URL without embedded credentials.
http_local_only: The plugin API permits plain HTTP only to localhost / 127.0.0.1. Use HTTPS for other hosts.
invalid_headers: Use one Name: value per header line; values cannot contain line breaks.
permission: Permission not granted: {detail}. Enable the declared network capability in Settings → Plugins. For another HTTPS host, add net:host to plugin.toml and reload / reinstall.
endpoint: This endpoint is no longer available. Scan the project again.
